description: UCI row 68 (age 37, MEDIUM vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 4, horizon 8yr) — ig corporate bond etf: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Claudia Moreira is 37 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 32,400 euros (around 2,700 euros per month). They hold 2,100 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 2,300 euros with a 8-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate-to-conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 4 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 2,300 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the Bloomberg Euro Aggregate Corporate Index, holding EUR-denominated investment-grade bonds rated at minimum BBB-. The fund publishes a KID, trades on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and contains no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). The recommended minimum holding period is three years.
